In the Gospels it often advances the storyline ('then Jesus said'), while in the Epistles it marks logical inference ('therefore, since we have been justified by faith,' Rom 5:1). Its tone ranges from casual narrative transition to solemn theological summons. The translations capture this well: Spanish 'pues,' French 'donc,' German 'nun' — all marking logical or temporal sequence rather than adversative contrast."

All 505 occurrences express this single inferential-transitional role,...
